title: Snarky Puppy - Lingus (We Like It Here)
summary: A live, overdub-free performance of 'Lingus' by Snarky Puppy, from the 'We Like It Here' DVD recorded in Utrecht. It features a Cory Henry keyboard solo.
why: HN commenters recommend Snarky Puppy as proof that vibrant, progressive modern jazz is being made today.

quote.text: I highly recommend anything by Snarky Puppy.
